description: Creates a filter for mail that arrives from now on. To apply it to older mail too, run organize_emails with the same search.

account.description: Email address or label of the account (see list_accounts).

add_labels.description: Label names or IDs. System labels: INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT.

query.description: Gmail search the mail must match

remove_labels.description: Label names or IDs. System labels: INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT.

skip_inbox.description: Must be true to remove INBOX, i.e. to hide matching mail from the inbox. Only set it when the user asked for that explicitly.

name: create_filter
